events.content: Observatory 0.9.6 mechanics faithfully retained in standalone 3D-rendered room. 3D decorations/optics and art-ready geometry; original 2D scripted collision governs walking/bridge.

inlineCode: // One scene. Three refractors reconfigure light as shelter and physical bridge.
message:'ОПТИЧНІ ПРИСТРОЇ МОЖНА ПОВЕРТАТИ КЛАВІШЕЮ E.',messageClock:5.7,
// M1: physical bridge and a hand-off safe pool at its far shore.
// M2: a walking spotlight, then a fixed beam that doubles as iris input.
// M3: a rehearsal arc or long final cover.
['ПЕРШИЙ ПРОМІНЬ — У ЛІВИЙ КУТ','СВІТЛОВИЙ МІСТ МАТЕРІАЛІЗУВАВСЯ!','ПЕРШИЙ ПРОМІНЬ — ДО ПАВУКІВ'],
['ДРУГЕ ДЗЕРКАЛО — ВГОРУ','ПРОМІНЬ РУХАЄТЬСЯ. МОЖНА ЙТИ РАЗОМ ІЗ НИМ!','ДРУГИЙ ПРОМІНЬ ЗАКРІПИВСЯ НА ОПТИЧНОМУ ЗАМКУ'],
['ТРЕТЄ ДЗЕРКАЛО — ВГОРУ','ТРЕТІЙ ПРОМІНЬ КОЛИВАЄТЬСЯ','ТРЕТІЙ ПРОМІНЬ ОСВІТЛЮЄ ВИХІД']
if(irisOpen())announce('ДВА ПРОМЕНІ ПЕРЕТНУЛИСЯ — ОПТИЧНА ПЕРЕГОРОДКА РОЗКРИЛАСЯ!',4.2);
// The optical iris is a wall, not just a decorative goal marker.
// E operates one refractor at a time. No speed skill, throwing, lifting, switches, locks, keys.
// Spiders are vision-based only. Being inside ANY light zone is invisibility.
if(irisOpen()&&hidden()){s.won=true;s.flash=1;announce('ОБСЕРВАТОРІЮ ПРОЙДЕНО! ТИ ЗІБРАВ КОРИДОР ІЗ ПРОМЕНІВ.',99);}
// Render exactly three cyan beam cones tied to real optics, not decorative fake safe zones.
let task=!bridge()?'01 / ПУЛЬТ A: ПОВЕРНИ ПРОМІНЬ ТА СТВОРИ СВІТЛОВИЙ МІСТ [E].'
:!s.crossed?'02 / ПЕРЕЙДИ ПРОВАЛЛЯ ТА ЗНАЙДИ ПУЛЬТ B.'
:s.modes[2]===0?'04 / РУХАЙСЯ РАЗОМ ІЗ ПРОМЕНЕМ ДО ПУЛЬТА C.'
:!irisOpen()?'06 / ПЕРЕНАЛАШТУЙ ПУЛЬТ B ДЛЯ ВІДКРИТТЯ ЗАТВОРА.'
if(s.won)task='ОБСЕРВАТОРІЮ ПРОЙДЕНО — ТИ ПРОКЛАВ ШЛЯХ ІЗ СВІТЛА.';

events.content: ПІСЛЯСВІТ 3D / Official GDevelop Starting 3D Platformer physics and character controls; first room of the sunken harbor.

inlineCode: // Spalakh 3D — first puzzle room. GDevelop Starting 3D Platformer physics and controls preserved.
// 0.2 cinematic greybox: dark scene background, no authored surface textures.
// 2.5D presentation: keep Physics3D Player as an invisible collider.
// The 3D boxes below are flat camera-readable PNG planes, not colliders.
// The "top/bottom" 3D box faces are the vertical XZ faces (camera looks along Y).
// Keep the artwork centred on the physics capsule, not offset one sprite width.
q.setX(px-150);q.setY(44);q.setZ(pz-28); // 0.5.2: feet align closer to the top of the physical platform
// Flip image horizontally without rotating the vertical XZ plane edge-on.
// A very soft emissive aura behind the sprite, and a diffuse footprint
// on the deck. Neither object has any collision or gameplay behavior.
const ember=obj('EmberLight');if(ember){ember.setX(px);ember.setY(0);} // PointLight3D has no setZ(); its height is fixed in the scene.
// Visual tutorial: a visible hero and one highlighted goal at a time.
// 0.4: Hero silhouette, eyes and flame strands are now a single emissive GLB
// driven by the existing Physics3D/PhysicsCharacter3D Player body.
// The crate-cap is purely decorative and follows the physics body.
const stageTitles=['01/04  ЗНАЙДИ ЧЕРВОНИЙ БУЙ  →','02/04  ШТОВХАЙ ЯЩИК НА ПЛИТУ  →','03/04  ЗАРЯДИ БІРЮЗОВИЙ СЕНСОР  →','04/04  ПРОЙДИ У ВІДКРИТИЙ ШЛЮЗ  →'];
'Іди до маячка праворуч. A/D — рух, SPACE — стрибок.',
'Підійди до ящика ЗЛІВА та штовхай праворуч на зелену плиту.',
'Біля сенсора утримуй F і рухайся A/D: світловий шлейф його зарядить.',
'Шлюз відкрито! Іди праворуч. У світлі риба тебе не бачить.'
txt('TutorialTitle',goalIndex===0 && px>940 ? '01/04  БУЙ ЗАЛИШИВСЯ ПОЗАДУ  ←' : stageTitles[goalIndex]);
else if(s.buoy&&!s.plate&&Math.abs(px-bx)<215)prompt='ШТОВХАЙ ЯЩИК ПРАВОРУЧ  →  НА ЗЕЛЕНУ ПЛИТУ';
// Character label removed; the glowing hero itself guides the first seconds.
// Room title remains static; current objective is in TutorialTitle.
if(s.completed){txt('TutorialTitle','ЧУДОВО!  ПЕРШУ ГОЛОВОЛОМКУ ПРОЙДЕНО.');txt('TutorialHelp','Рух, світло та сенсори — основа майбутнього світу Спалаха.');}

tests.description: Pressing Space makes the 3D character jump off the ground, and gravity brings it back down.
tests.name: Jumping with Space
source: // Space must make the physics character jump off the ground
harness.assert(characterState().IsOnFloor === true, 'The player stands on the ground.');
// Doing nothing must leave the player on the ground.
'The player stays on the ground while no key is pressed.'
harness.assert(sawJumping, 'The character reports it is jumping after pressing Space.');
harness.assert(leftTheFloor, 'The player leaves the floor when jumping.');
'The player rises well above the ground when jumping (rose by ' +
harness.assert(landedBack, 'The player falls back onto the ground.');
'The player lands back at the height it jumped from.'

tests.description: The player walks forward into a coin lying on the ground: the coin is picked up.
tests.name: Collecting a coin by walking into it
source: // Walking into a coin must collect it: the events delete a Coin as soon as
// it is within 50 units of the Player.
// "w" walks the character toward the direction it faces.
const forward = { x: Math.cos(forwardRadians), y: Math.sin(forwardRadians) };
// Arrange: stand the player back from a coin lying on the ground, so that
// the coin is straight ahead. Reaching it is still up to the game.
harness.assert(groundCoins.length > 0, 'There are coins lying on the ground.');
// Standing away from the coin must not collect anything: this is what makes
// the check below a test of the player walking into it.
'The coin to walk into is still there once the player is in place.'
'Walking forward into the coin collects it (the player ended up ' +
'The number of coins left in the level went down.'
// A picture of what the game looks like once this has happened, kept with
await harness.takeScreenshot('the player standing where the coin was');
